description: This source file defines an Android activity called ShapeDrawable1 that demonstrates various shape drawable types and shaders using the Android graphics framework. It includes classes for custom shape drawables and methods to create different shader effects, and it visualizes these shapes in a custom view.

classes.name: ShapeDrawable1
classes.description: Main activity class extending GraphicsActivity that sets up the content view.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Custom View subclass handling the drawing of various shape drawables with different shaders.

classes.name: MyShapeDrawable
classes.description: Custom ShapeDrawable subclass that draws a shape with a stroke paint in addition to the shape's fill.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Android activity lifecycle method that initializes the activity and sets the content view.

methods.name: makeSweep
methods.description: Creates and returns a SweepGradient shader for coloring shapes with a sweep gradient effect.

methods.name: makeLinear
methods.description: Creates and returns a LinearGradient shader for linear gradient coloring.

methods.name: makeTiling
methods.description: Creates and returns a BitmapShader with a small bitmap pattern for tiling effects.

methods.name: getStrokePaint
methods.description: Returns the Paint object used for stroking in the custom MyShapeDrawable class.
